key_reasoning.reason: Four components: the bin/codemie.js launcher, the new builtin-only bin/relaunch.js relay (a new abstraction), the cli-updater service (update-result contract) and the fake-npm test helper.

Child-process relay with signal forwarding, exit-status and signal re-raise policy that differs per platform (win32, TTY, non-TTY), plus an env-marker loop guard. No exact precedent in the repo, and a mistake can cause a relaunch loop or lost exit codes. Rollback is trivial (revert the launcher).

11 files changed per the diffstat (902 insertions, 17 deletions): 4 source and doc files, 2 unit test files, 1 new helper and 3 integration tests, plus CHANGELOG and CONFIGURATION docs. About 800 of the added lines are test code.
